intent: Create one ultrawide 21:9 heightened but physically readable Chinese-fantasy film frame: a rescue decision is visible at the instant a mountain bridge fails.

direction.world_rule: magic changes matter through visible contact and cost

cinematic.visible_event: a woman catches her companion's wrist one instant before the broken bridge deck drops away
cinematic.relationship_pressure: she must choose between keeping her sword hand free and holding him
cinematic.viewer_task: read the unstable grip, then discover the abyss and the falling bridge
cinematic.viewer_position: crouched behind a wet stone lion at the surviving end of the bridge
cinematic.frozen_moment: their hands have just locked; his boots have lost the deck but have not begun a full swing
cinematic.withheld_information: what pursues them remains beyond the frame

scene.summary: an ancient chain-and-stone bridge between rain-dark mountain gates above a cloud-filled abyss
scene.setting: weathered Chinese mountain pass, wet carved stone, torn prayer ribbons, distant cliff temples

subjects.description: one adult Chinese swordswoman in dark indigo travel robes
appearance: sheathed sword pulling at her free side
subjects.action: bracing one knee and catching the other character by the wrist
subjects.pose: torso twisted toward the drop, shoulder and back visibly bearing load
relationships: her right hand supports the companion's wrist while her left palm braces on wet stone

subjects.description: one adult Chinese male traveler in weathered gray robes
appearance: small medicine case strapped across his chest
subjects.action: falling with one wrist caught and the other hand reaching for the bridge edge
subjects.pose: hips below the deck line, legs pulled downward by the collapsing slab
subjects.gaze: toward the rescuer's hand, not toward camera
relationships: one clear wrist-to-hand rescue contact; no duplicated or contested grip

staging.primary_relationship: rescuer anchored to surviving stone, companion suspended over the break
staging.eyeline_logic: both attention lines converge on the grip
staging.screen_direction: bridge collapse travels from upper-right toward lower-right while rescue force pulls back left
staging.axis: the bridge chain and both forearms preserve one readable tension axis
staging.occlusion: foreground stone lion hides part of the rescuer's planted leg but not the grip
staging.attention_path: joined hands to loaded shoulder to falling deck to cloud abyss

spatial_dynamics.dominant_read: the loaded wrist grip between the two travelers
spatial_dynamics.secondary_read: stone slabs and chains peeling into the abyss
spatial_dynamics.beauty_mechanism: a bright skin-and-wet-cloth contact point inside a diagonal field of dark stone and cloud
spatial_dynamics.tension_source: rescue force pulls left while gravity and collapsing masonry pull down-right
spatial_dynamics.realism_anchor: anatomically plausible shoulders, wrists, load path, wet friction and falling debris
spatial_dynamics.action_vector: joined hands pull back toward the surviving gate
spatial_dynamics.counterforce: gravity, the companion's weight and the falling bridge pull toward the abyss
spatial_dynamics.foreground_role: wet stone lion and chain establish the viewer's low, sheltered position
spatial_dynamics.midground_role: the two bodies and grip carry story and force
spatial_dynamics.background_role: broken bridge, cliff temples and cloud depth prove scale
spatial_dynamics.depth_transition: stone lion edge leads to hands, bodies, fracture, falling slabs and cloud void
spatial_dynamics.parallax_logic: near stone and chain cross faster than the distant cliff temples
motion_evidence: prayer ribbons streaming with the same wind
spatial_dynamics.readability_guard: keep both arms, the single grip, the deck edge and open fall clearly separated

composition.camera_angle: low oblique angle just above the surviving deck
composition.perspective: heightened near-field perspective with stable anatomy
composition.point_of_view: same-side witness behind the stone lion
composition.camera_motivation: put the viewer close enough to feel the grip while retaining the abyss
composition.camera_distance: close foreground anchor, both bodies readable in the midground
composition.lens_rationale: exaggerate the bridge fracture and depth without stretching faces or hands
composition.framing: joined hands near the central visual hinge, heads separated, fall open to lower-right
composition.camera_pitch: slight downward pitch into the gap
composition.perspective_distortion: controlled expansion of near stone and chain; faces and hands remain natural
composition.edge_behavior: falling slabs may crop at right edge; no stretched anatomy at edges
composition.crop_pressure: tight on surviving left gate, open toward the fall
composition.camera_state: handheld but frozen at the decisive contact
composition.action_readability: one unambiguous rescue grip and one collapsing direction
composition.negative_space: cloud abyss remains an empty value field beneath the companion

lighting.summary: storm-blue ambient sky with one dying amber gate lantern reflected in rain
lighting.motivation: cold predawn sky, wet stone bounce and one practical lantern
lighting.narrative_function: the warm reflection isolates the joined hands while the abyss stays cold
lighting.rim: only a restrained rain edge from the visible lantern
lighting.direction: upper-left sky and left gate practical
lighting.contrast: readable shadow floor with contained practical highlight
lighting.color_temperature: cold blue-gray environment with localized dim amber
practicals: one gate lantern at far left

color_pipeline.exposure_strategy: protect rain highlights and skin while retaining the cloud abyss
color_pipeline.tonal_curve: dense midtones with a long highlight shoulder
color_pipeline.highlight_rolloff: smooth and contained around the practical lantern
color_pipeline.shadow_floor: dark but readable wet cloth and stone
color_pipeline.white_balance: cold ambient with locally warm reflected practical
color_pipeline.color_separation: skin and indigo remain distinct from wet stone
color_pipeline.skin_tone_policy: natural muted skin under mixed cold and amber light
color_pipeline.saturation_policy: restrained except for the small amber contact cue

film_emulation.grain: fine irregular grain visible mainly in midtones
film_emulation.halation: minimal and limited to the visible lantern
film_emulation.bloom: very restrained around the same lantern

style.realism: heightened perspective within physically credible bodies, cloth, rain, stone and gravity

quality_controls: natural hand anatomy and wrist alignment
rain detail concentrated around contact and fracture
